rationale: Steven is building TinyHumans AI with a conviction that personal AI should be private, local, and UI-first — exactly the developer experience and tooling problems Lydia specializes in solving. With Steven's TypeScript/React stack and Lydia's deep expertise in developer experience at Anthropic (Claude Code team), Vercel, and Bun, they can exchange valuable perspectives on making AI agents accessible to developers and end-users alike.
intro_message: Steven Enamakel, meet Lydia Hallie — you're both at the intersection of AI tooling and developer experience, and Lydia's work on Claude Code at Anthropic could directly inform how TinyHumans approaches UI-first, accessible AI agents.
